en: ### What is included  One persistent shell tool, read_image, and a fixed system prompt. Image reading requires an image-capable model. Older history is compacted automatically under context pressure; use /compact while the agent is idle to compact it manually. The built-in preset does not load Skills, planning, or the standard runtime context.  ### When to choose it  Use it as a baseline for experiments and comparisons. It can still read files and execute scripts through shell commands, but offers fewer built-in ways to manage a long task. Fewer tools does not necessarily make it easier for a beginner.
tr: ### Ano ang kasama  Isang persistent na shell tool, read_image, at isang nakatakdang system prompt. Ang pagbasa ng imahe ay nangangailangan ng modelong kayang magbasa ng imahe. Ang mas lumang kasaysayan ay awtomatikong kino-compact kapag may pressure sa context; gamitin ang /compact habang hindi aktibo ang agent upang i-compact ito nang manu-mano. Ang built-in na preset ay hindi naglo-load ng Skills, pagpaplano, o ng karaniwang runtime context.  ### Kailan ito pipiliin  Gamitin ito bilang baseline para sa mga eksperimento at paghahambing. Nakakabasa pa rin ito ng mga file at nakakapagpatakbo ng mga script sa pamamagitan ng mga shell command, ngunit may mas kaunting built-in na paraan upang pamahalaan ang mahabang gawain. Ang mas kaunting tool ay hindi nangangahulugang mas madali ito para sa isang baguhan.

en: The agent uses a terminal and image reading, with context compaction. Useful for testing and comparing its basic performance.

en: ### What is included  One persistent shell tool, read_image, and a fixed system prompt. Image reading requires an image-capable model. Older history is compacted automatically under context pressure; use /compact while the agent is idle to compact it manually. The built-in preset does not load Skills, planning, or the standard runtime context.  ### When to choose it  Use it as a baseline for experiments and comparisons. It can still read files and execute scripts through shell commands, but offers fewer built-in ways to manage a long task. Fewer tools does not necessarily make it easier for a beginner.
tr: ### Kí ni ó wà nínú  Irinṣẹ́ ìkára kan tí ó dúró ṣinṣin, read_image, àti ìtọ́nisọ́nà ètò tí ó dúró. Kíkà àwòrán nílò mọ́dẹ́lì tí ó lè kà àwòrán. Ìtàn àtijọ́ ń fúnpọ̀ fúnra rẹ̀ lábẹ́ ìfúnpá ọ̀rọ̀ àyíká; lo /compact nígbà tí aṣojú náà bá wà ní ìsinmi láti fún un pọ̀ lọ́wọ́. Àtúnṣe tí ó wà nínú rẹ̀ kò gbé Ọgbọ́n, ètò, tàbí ọ̀rọ̀ àyíká ìṣiṣẹ́ déédéé.  ### Ìgbà láti yàn án  Lò ó gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìpìlẹ̀ fún àwọn àdánwò àti ìfiwéra. Ó ṣì lè kà àwọn fáìlì àti ṣiṣẹ́ àwọn àkọsílẹ̀ àṣẹ nípasẹ̀ àwọn àṣẹ ìkára, ṣùgbọ́n ó ní ọ̀nà díẹ̀ tí ó wà nínú rẹ̀ láti ṣàkóso iṣẹ́ gígùn. Irinṣẹ́ díẹ̀ kò túmọ̀ sí pé ó rọrùn fún olùbẹ̀rẹ̀.
